targets.claim: Choose two or three frames of the same wood molding.
If joining two frames, use identical frames.
If joining three frames, choose either three of the same or one larger frame as the middle frame.
Lay the frames beside each other to see if you like the effect.
Mark the hinge placement on the connecting sides of the frames.
The hinge placement must be the same distance from the bottom edges of each frame to ensure stability.
Attach two small hinges to the connecting sides of the frames.
Screw each frame to the backer board, and repeat with each frame.
Save time by having the pictures ready in the frames.
Hang up the frames and step back to enjoy the results.
